reference_feature_semantics: The standoff value locates the module body's nearest host-facing local-X face. The body occupies local X from standoff through standoff + body.depth_m. It is not a body-center offset.
axis_semantics: module local +X maps to each source socket outward normal
truth_boundary: This policy makes the existing Object standoff anchor explicit without changing host/module source bytes or proof geometry. It proves only which existing module body face the scalar standoff locates and the already-established source-space clearance derived from that interpretation. It does not establish engineering tolerances, fastener/tool envelopes, retention, collision/physics, runtime attachment, gameplay, visual acceptance, CANON or production readiness.
